mapper.insert: insert into employee (username, password, status, role, employeename, departmentid, phone, email) values (#{username}, #{password}, #{status}, #{role}, #{employeename}, #{departmentid}, #{phone}, #{email})
mapper.select:
select e.*,d.* from employee as e,department as d where e.departmentid = d.departmentid and e.is_delete = 0
and e.employeename like concat('%',#{employeename},'%')
and e.phone like concat('%',#{phone},'%')
and e.email like concat('%',#{email},'%')
and d.departmentname like concat('%',#{departmentname},'%')
select * from employee where status = 0 and is_delete = 0

SELECT e.employeeid, e.employeename, e.email, e.phone, mp.status, d.departmentname, m.meetingid, m.signinstarttime, m.signinendtime, mp.checkintime, mp.location FROM employee as e, meetingparticipants as mp, department as d, meeting as m where mp.meetingid = #{meetingid} AND e.employeeid = mp.employeeid AND e.departmentid = d.departmentid AND m.meetingid = mp.meetingid
select * from employee where status = 1 and is_delete = 0
SELECT e.employeeid, e.employeename, e.username, e.phone, e.email, d.departmentname, e.role, e.status FROM employee as e, department as d WHERE e.departmentid = d.departmentid AND e.is_delete = 0
